Management Plan

- Working diagnosis: Probable migraine based on unilateral headache, visual disturbance, nausea/vomiting, and lack of focal neurological symptoms by history.
- Treatment advised:
  - Trial ibuprofen (dose not specified) plus an over-the-counter antiemetic (unspecified; dose not specified).
  - Sugary carbonated drink (e.g., cola) suggested alongside medications.
- Follow-up:
  - Same-day in-person appointment arranged for full neurological assessment; if symptoms resolve substantially before the appointment, patient may cancel.
  - Advised to contact the clinic if symptoms worsen or do not improve with recommended measures prior to the appointment.
- Patient education:
  - Discussed typical features and variable duration of migraines (can last 4–72 hours; some improve within 30–40 minutes after treatment).
